next."), mdx("p", null, "Which fixes the job permanently, for me and for anyone else building on this:

token written is another pass through the machine. Merrill and Sabharwal put a

", mdx("a", {

because the amount is what matters. A logarithmic number of steps barely lifts
the ceiling. A linear number buys a real new class of problems. A polynomial
number lands you at exactly the problems solvable in polynomial time. The
question was never whether it writes, it was how much."), mdx("p", null, "A scratchpad is still a blank page, and blank pages get filled with whatever is

step.” “You are a senior security reviewer.” The personas felt silly and worked
anyway, for an unglamorous reason: naming a role pulls the prediction onto the
paths where that role’s writing lives. You are not motivating anyone, you are

reasoning traces to imitate, and paid reward only on whether the final answer

", mdx("a", {

puts the sharper point on it: context is a finite resource with diminishing
returns."), mdx("p", null, "That reframing is the whole discipline. Not “write a better prompt” but “spend a
budget”. Dumping everything in is not thoroughness, it is noise, and noise moves
the prediction onto worse paths. Once you see the window as a budget, every
memory file, every retrieval call, every compaction step, every dynamically
loaded tool schema and every cached prefix becomes a line item you can argue
about."), mdx("p", null, "And then you are left with a harness that has good memory and good tools, and

    "href": "https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents"

agents"), " draws

model deciding them. Loop engineering is setting that dial per step, and mostly

needs you to know a good answer when you see one. Harness engineering needs a

", mdx("a", {
    parentName: "p",
    "href": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moravec%27s_paradox"
  }, "Moravec’s paradox"), " with new
hardware: the reasoning we find hard is cheap, and the sensorimotor competence a

the second is the mistake I run into most often."), mdx("p", null, "The second is taste, and this one makes people angry, so let me be careful. AI

command."), mdx("p", null, "So the pattern is bigger than five leaks and five patches. It is a cycle. We
